isolation_boundary: All files in bench/comparators/sota_head_to_head/ are excluded from runtime wheels and sdist archives (MANIFEST.in 'prune bench'; pyproject.toml packages only src/). Third-party comparator libraries must be installed only in an isolated external virtual environment outside the clean ephemeris-oss runtime.

horizons_de441_e2_accuracy.source_oracle: NASA JPL Horizons DE441 QUANTITIES=45 apparent geocentric ICRF RA/DEC

horizons_geodetic_vertical_vectors.source_oracle: NASA JPL Horizons EPHEM_TYPE=VECTORS CENTER='coord@399' dual-altitude (0 km and 1 km) ICRF observer vectors + USNO/IERS finals2000A.all snapshot

iers_finals2000a_all.note: IERS Rapid Service updates Bulletin A daily. Historical finals rows (1975, 2000, 2016, 2019) are fixed; 2026-11-03 EOP varies by less than 0.01 arcsec across Bulletin A updates, and the exact snapshot from the retained run is preserved in horizons-geodetic-vertical-vectors.json.

external_archive_disclosure.redistribution_limitation: External .se1 planetary and lunar ephemeris files (sepl_18.se1, semo_18.se1, seas_18.se1 for 1800..2399 CE) are third-party copyleft upstream assets and cannot be redistributed inside this Apache-2.0 repository or its release archives.
external_archive_disclosure.behavior_when_omitted: When --se1-dir is omitted, run_sota_head_to_head.py still executes all zero-download and SPK-backed slots (including SE 2.10.03 built-in Moshier, Skyfield 1.55, Astropy 8.0.2, PyEphem 4.2.1, and RDG-Ephemeris) and marks only the external .se1 slot SKIPPED_NO_EXTERNAL_SE1_ARCHIVE.
